node.title: Re^5: How to use cgi table in index.pm perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I treid but doesnt work for me

Sorry, but if you don't show what's wrong, we can't help. Please see [id://174051], [id://510718] and [id://1177642].

Storing a value returned from a function in a variable and returning that value from a subroutine are fairly basic operations - I'd recommend a full read of [doc://perlintro], which will show you those basics.
